origin.quote: Accuracy 94.7 % 1,459 / 1,540 correct; Reader: gpt-5.4 (reasoning = medium). Judge: gpt-5.4 with chain-of-thought grading.

limits: Zep measured its own product, and it is above the audit's ceiling.
